text.en:
Section four of Republic Act Numbered Four thousand three hundred seventy-four is hereby
amended by adding a sub-paragraph to read as follows:
(i) Give two kinds of examinations, namely:
1. Junior Geodetic Engineer; and
2. Geodetic Engineer"

Section fifteen of the same Act is hereby amended by adding a sub-paragraph to read as follows:
(e) To qualify in the Junior Geodetic Engineer Examination, he must, likewise, satisfy the foregoing

requirements (a) to (c) of this Section and he shall have completed an Associate in Surveying or third year in
Geodetic Engineering course or fourth year Civil Engineering course; Provided, That those Civil Engineering
undergraduates must also have completed or earned to their credit the following courses: Laws on Natural
Resources, Land Registration and Property, Land Reform Laws, Land Property Surveys, Photogrammetry and
Cartography from any recognized school, college or university. The certificate to be issued if he qualifies shall
authorize him to execute land property surveys for judicial and administrative land registration proceedings;
Provided, That this provision shall not affect those geodetic engineers to whom the Board has issued the
Geodetic Engineering Certificate."

This Degree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-three.
